intro: Waxing every three weeks, ingrown hairs, razor bumps and dark, bumpy underarms are why most patients ask about laser hair removal. A pulse of laser light is absorbed by the pigment in the hair, heating and disabling the follicle while the skin surface is protected.

For Indian skin, which is mostly Fitzpatrick type IV to V, the choice of laser matters. At Skin Essence in Kalyani Nagar, hair reduction is performed on the Coolite BOLT, an 1800 W diode laser platform that fires three wavelengths, 755, 810 and 1064 nm, in a single pulse. The 1064 nm wavelength reaches deep follicles and is the safest choice for darker skin, while a sapphire-cooled tip keeps the skin surface cold as the follicle is heated. Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist, sets the parameters for your skin tone, hair thickness and the area treated.

It is more accurate to call this hair reduction than removal: a full course reduces growth substantially and regrowth is finer and lighter. Hormonal areas, such as the chin in PCOS, usually need maintenance sessions.
whoIsItFor: Women who want full-body, face, underarm, arm, leg or bikini hair reduction instead of waxing, threading or shaving
Men who want beard or eyebrow shaping, or less hair on the ears, chest and shoulders
Patients with PCOS-related facial hair, alongside hormonal treatment
Recurrent folliculitis, razor bumps or darkening from repeated waxing
Brides and grooms starting 6 to 8 months ahead of the wedding

howItWorks.title: Consultation and test patch
howItWorks.description: We assess your skin type, hair colour and thickness, rule out conditions that need treating first, and do a test patch if your skin is sensitive or tanned.

howItWorks.title: Preparation
howItWorks.description: Shave the area 24 hours before. Avoid waxing, threading or plucking for 4 weeks and tanning for 2 weeks; the laser needs the hair root in place and untanned skin.

howItWorks.title: The session
howItWorks.description: Gel is applied and the sapphire-cooled handpiece is moved over the area. Each pulse feels like a warm snap under a cold tip, and the large spot size keeps sessions short: underarms take about 10 minutes, full legs about 40.

howItWorks.title: Between sessions
howItWorks.description: Treated hair sheds over 1 to 3 weeks. Sessions are spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart on the face and 6 to 8 weeks on the body to catch hair in its growth phase.

sessionsAndDowntime.downtime: None; mild redness for a few hours

aftercare: Mild redness or small bumps for a few hours are normal; a cold compress settles them.
Apply sunscreen daily and avoid direct sun, saunas and hot yoga for 48 hours.
Do not wax, thread or pluck between sessions; shaving is fine.
Skip scrubs, retinoids and perfumed products on the treated area for 3 days.

faqs.q: Is laser hair removal safe for dark or Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, with the right laser and settings. The Coolite BOLT combines 755, 810 and 1064 nm with sapphire skin cooling, and its 1064 nm output is intended for skin types V and VI. Burns or pigmentation come from wrong settings or tanned skin, which is why sessions are dermatologist-supervised.

faqs.q: Do you offer laser hair reduction for men?
faqs.a: Yes. Beard shaping for a clean cheek and neck line, eyebrow shaping between and above the brows with protective eye shields, ears, chest and shoulders are the areas men ask for most. Male hair is coarser and may need a session or two more.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Most areas need 6 to 8 sessions. Coarse, dark hair responds fastest; fine or hormonal hair may need more sessions and yearly maintenance.

faqs.q: How long do the results last?
faqs.a: After a full course most patients have far less hair and finer regrowth. Some regrowth over time is normal, and hormonal areas may need an occasional touch-up.
Most patients describe a warm snap, like a rubber band, made tolerable by the sapphire-cooled tip. The upper lip and bikini line sting more; numbing cream can be applied if needed.

faqs.q: What does laser hair removal cost in Pune?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the area and number of sessions; a package lowers the per-session cost. Exact pricing is confirmed at your consultation.
